title: Top 5 SaaS Reseller Programs Worth Joining in 2026
summary: Not all SaaS reseller programs are worth your time. Here are five that offer real earning potential in 2026, including one built specifically for the African market.
body_markdown:
SaaS reseller programs offer recurring revenue, lower risk than building your own product, faster time to market, and commission rates that typically range from 20 to 40%, significantly higher than the 5 to 20% earned through standard affiliate referrals.


The model is compelling. But not all reseller programs are worth joining. For example, some pay well but require significant product expertise and long sales cycles. Others offer strong brand recognition but have saturated partner networks, making competition for clients intense. Also, some programs sound generous until you read the fine print on payout timing, minimum volume commitments, and client ownership terms.


The best reseller program is not the one with the flashiest partner page. It is the one that fits your network, your client base, and your ability to sell and support the product profitably.


This guide evaluates five SaaS reseller programs worth joining in 2026, covering what each one pays, who it is best suited for, and what to watch out for before signing up.

### What to Look for in a SaaS Reseller Program Before You Join


Before evaluating specific programs, consider the criteria that separate a genuinely valuable reseller partnership from one that looks good on paper:


**Commission structure and payout timing.** A[high commission rate](https://tryduplo.com/blog/earn-100000-for-every-business-you-refer-to-duplo/) that pays quarterly is worth less than a lower rate that pays monthly. Ask specifically: when does the commission trigger, when is it paid, and what happens if the client churns before the payout date.


**Client ownership.** Some programs give you the client relationship and recurring revenue for as long as the client stays. Others treat you as a one-time referral source. The difference in long-term earning potential is significant.


**Product demand in your market.** A globally recognised product with low penetration in your specific market is a better reseller opportunity than a saturated one. For partners operating in Nigeria and Africa, this factor alone can determine whether a program is worth pursuing.


**Support and onboarding.** Before signing with any program, ask for the current partner rate sheet, minimum volume commitments, payout timing, and co-selling and support terms. These often matter more than the headline commission rates.


##### 1. HubSpot Solutions Partner Program


**Best for:** Marketing agencies, consultants, and digital agencies serving SMB and mid-market companies.


[HubSpot’s Solutions Partner Program](https://www.hubspot.com/partners) is one of the most recognised reseller programs in the global SaaS market. Partners sell HubSpot’s CRM, marketing automation, sales, and customer service tools to their clients, earning commissions on new business and renewals.


HubSpot’s platform allows partners to bundle software with strategy, implementation, and ongoing services, making it one of the higher-value programs for agencies that can deliver end-to-end solutions rather than just software licences.


**What you earn:** Tiered commission structure based on managed recurring revenue. Higher tiers unlock better rates and co-marketing support.


**What to watch out for:** The HubSpot partner market is competitive. The program rewards partners who can deliver implementation and ongoing services, not just software referrals. If your model is pure referral rather than managed services, the earning potential is lower than the headline suggests.


**Verdict:** Strong program for agencies with the capacity to deliver HubSpot implementations. Less compelling for pure referral partners or those without an existing client base in marketing and sales technology.


##### 2. Zoho Partner Program


**Best for:** IT consultants, accounting firms, and business advisors serving SMEs in African and emerging markets.


[Zoho’s partner program](https://www.zoho.com/partners/) covers its full suite of business applications including CRM, accounting, HR, project management, and collaboration tools. The program has particular relevance for partners operating in African markets because Zoho has invested significantly in the region and its pricing is competitive for SME budgets.


Partners who serve clients needing CRM, business support tools, or operational software will find strong product-market fit here, particularly across the Nigerian SME segment where Zoho’s pricing sits within an accessible range.


**What you earn:** Reseller discounts of up to 30% on Zoho products, which you can pass through partially or retain as margin depending on your pricing model.


**What to watch out for:** Zoho’s broad product suite means partners need to develop expertise across multiple products to serve clients effectively. Specialising in one or two Zoho products is more achievable for most partners than attempting to cover the full suite.


**Verdict:** One of the stronger reseller programs for partners operating in Nigerian and African markets, combining recognised brand with relevant product coverage and competitive pricing for the SME segment.


##### 3. QuickBooks ProAdvisor Program


**Best for:** Accounting firms, bookkeepers, and finance consultants whose clients use QuickBooks for accounting.


[The QuickBooks ProAdvisor Program](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/accountants/proadvisor/) allows accounting professionals to resell QuickBooks subscriptions to clients at a discount while earning ongoing revenue share. For accounting firms already advising clients on financial management, the program monetises a recommendation they are likely already making.


**What you earn:** Up to 30% revenue share on QuickBooks subscriptions referred through the ProAdvisor program, recurring for as long as the client remains active.


**What to watch out for:** The program is designed for accounting professionals rather than general technology resellers. Partners without an accounting or finance advisory background will find client acquisition harder than the commission structure suggests.


**Verdict:** The highest-fit program for accountants and finance consultants. The earning potential is modest per client but compounds meaningfully across a portfolio of advisory relationships over time.


##### 4. Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider Program


**Best for:** IT firms, managed service providers, and technology consultants serving business clients.


The[Microsoft CSP program](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/partner-center/enroll/csp-overview) allows partners to resell Microsoft 365, Azure, Dynamics 365, and other Microsoft cloud products directly to business clients. Microsoft generates over USD 32 billion annually from reseller partnerships, a figure that reflects the scale of the ecosystem and the sustained global demand for Microsoft cloud products across every business segment.


**What you earn:** Margin on Microsoft product resale, set by Microsoft’s wholesale pricing and the retail price you charge clients. Partners at higher tiers access better wholesale rates.


**What to watch out for:** The program requires investment in Microsoft certifications and ongoing training to access the better commission tiers. For partners without an existing IT managed services practice, the barrier to meaningful earnings is higher than most other programs on this list.


**Verdict:** The highest-volume program on this list but also the most demanding in terms of expertise and infrastructure required to participate effectively. Best suited to established IT firms rather than individual consultants or agencies new to reselling.

### Frequently Asked Questions


**What is a SaaS reseller program?**
A SaaS reseller program allows individuals and companies to sell a software vendor’s product to their own clients. In return, they earn commissions or revenue share. Unlike affiliate programs, resellers typically take on more responsibility. This can include sales, customer onboarding, and ongoing support. Commission rates for SaaS reseller programs typically range from 20 to 40%. Standard affiliate referrals usually offer 5 to 20%.


**How much can you earn from a SaaS reseller program?**
Earning potential varies by program and the size of your network. It also depends on how relevant the product is to your audience. Global programs like HubSpot and Microsoft offer recurring commissions. These can compound as your managed client base grows. The Duplo Partners program pays a fixed ₦100,000 per successful business referral with no cap. This makes it a strong earning opportunity for partners with Nigerian business networks.


**What is the best SaaS reseller program in Nigeria?**
For partners with networks of Nigerian business owners, CFOs, and finance managers, the Duplo Partners program offers ₦100,000 per successful referral. There is no minimum volume requirement and no cap on total earnings. This makes it an attractive option for partners with access to Nigerian businesses.


**What is the difference between a SaaS reseller and an affiliate?**
An affiliate earns a commission for referring a lead that converts. A reseller typically takes on more of the sales and onboarding process. Resellers may also earn recurring revenue while the client remains active. Some programs, including Duplo Partners, use a hybrid model. The partner makes the introduction while the vendor handles onboarding. This combines the simplicity of an affiliate model with higher per-referral earnings.


**How do I choose the right SaaS reseller program?**
Start with three factors. First, consider how well the product fits your network’s actual needs. Next, compare the commission structure with the effort required to close each referral. Finally, look at the support and onboarding the vendor provides after the introduction. Programs with low barriers to entry and high per-referral earnings can help you generate revenue faster. Programs that require product expertise and certification may offer more long-term potential if you already have the skills to meet those requirements.
